title: 05_proto_valve_speed
interpretation: Event-free proto_valve vs the full event-driven sepsis_sbml model, both run through the identical process-bigraph Composite harness on this machine (severity 3, 2 h model time, 10 s interval). Removing the per-beat E_beat event and the piecewise pulOpen valve removes all CVODE root returns and reinitializations, giving a measured 1.20x speedup (284.0 s -> 236.1 s) within the same exact-SBML engine. The absolute seconds are harness-driven (per-interval reset + parameter re-apply) and are higher than the prototype report's raw-wheel single-call timings; only the ratio is comparable across arms, and both arms pay the overhead identically. The prototype report's raw-wheel measurements give a consistent 1.24-1.44x over 30 min to 48 h.
